A feature release: log any reading, or all of them, to CSV files.

## What changed

- Logging to CSV files. Right-click a reading and tick **Log to file**, or open Settings, Logging and tick **Log all hardware readings**. The collector writes the files, so logging goes on while the window is closed and starts again after you log in, until you stop it (Settings, Logging, **Stop logging**, which has Undo). The files go to `~/.local/state/hwglance/logs/` unless you choose another folder, one row per interval (every sample, or 2, 5, 10, 30 or 60 s), with values rounded the way the window shows them. A new file starts when the logged values change and each day.
- Finished log files are gzipped to `.csv.gz` by default (about a quarter of the size; LibreOffice and Excel need them unpacked first, pandas reads them as they are). An optional age limit (Delete logs older than 7, 30, 90 or 365 days, off by default) deletes old log files for good, and only HW Glance's own `hwglance-*.csv` and `.csv.gz` files.
- The top bar shows a **Logging** chip while a log is being written, or **Log error** when the file cannot be written. The chip opens Settings, Logging, which also shows the size to expect and what the log folder holds. Expect about 51 MB a day (13 MB compressed) for all of a typical PC's readings every second; fewer values or a longer interval shrink that in proportion.
- Reset all customisations keeps the logging choices, as it keeps the bar widget and alert choices.

The window and the collector must be the same version (protocol 6). The `systemctl --user restart hwglanced` step below covers it: a window started before the collector is restarted shows "Collector is older" until then.

The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/Raed-Alghamdi/hwglance/blob/v0.2.0/CHANGELOG.md).

## Install or update

Arch Linux, from the package attached below:

```sh
sudo pacman -U hwglance-0.2.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst
systemctl --user restart hwglanced
sudo systemctl restart hwglance-helper   # if you use the optional helper
hwglance-bar-widget update               # Omarchy only, if you installed the widget
```

For a first install, enable the services instead: `systemctl --user enable --now hwglanced` and, optionally, `sudo systemctl enable --now hwglance-helper`, then `hwglance-bar-widget install` on Omarchy.

Other x86_64 Linux distributions, from the tarball (prebuilt, no Rust needed):

```sh
tar -xzf hwglance-0.2.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz
cd hwglance-0.2.0-x86_64-linux
./install.sh
```

Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS`. Requirements and optional components are in the [README](https://github.com/Raed-Alghamdi/hwglance#what-you-need).
